sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Basic Materials / Building Materials · Indonesia. PT Superior Prima Sukses Tbk manufactures and sells autoclave aerated concrete products in Indonesia. The company offers lightweight bricks under the BLESSCON and SUPERIORE BLOCK brands, and instant cement products under the BLESSBOND brand. PT Superior Prima Sukses Tbk was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Surabaya, Indonesia.
